what_we_decided: 2026-01-06 - Primary framing: personal research library with knowledge graph, not just study synthesis tool
2026-01-06 - Aggressive deduplication: preprints/postprints and unannotated/annotated treated as version updates
2026-01-06 - Auto-process with flagging for manual review (maximize laziness/seamlessness)
2026-01-06 - Will rely on OCR for scanned PDFs and book scans (including two-page spreads)
2026-01-06 - Use GROBID for slow/comprehensive processing (~30s per paper, worth it for capabilities)
2026-01-06 - Use OCRmyPDF + Unpaper for scanned PDFs and two-page spread handling
2026-01-06 - Citation parsing: extract and store in MVP, defer retrieval to Phase 2
2026-01-06 - MVP metadata: authors, year, title, venue, volume/pages, DOI, abstract, page count
2026-01-06 - Development order: Start with arXiv papers (high quality, no annotations) as v0.1.0 MVP, expand to undergrad papers (mixed quality, annotations) in v0.1.5
2026-01-06 - MVP synthesis: summaries + 'why did I care' context, flashcards deferred, connections fuzzy/deferred
2026-01-06 - Acquisition sources: cast wide net including gray-market (user has legitimate access, just poor quality copies)
2026-01-07 - Use Obsidian as primary output interface - fast generation, excellent search, graph view for connections
2026-01-08 - Two-tier synthesis: quick preview (MVP) + detailed section-by-section summary (on-demand per paper)
2026-01-08 - Link all citations in paper notes, defer author pages to post-MVP
2026-01-08 - Use full author list for citation disambiguation (Smith, Jones & Chen 2023 vs Smith, Lee & Park 2023)
2026-01-08 - Use uv for Python package management instead of pip/venv
2026-01-08 - Target Python 3.14+ (latest features, no backwards compatibility needed)
2026-01-08 - Use real GROBID calls for testing (not mocks) - easier integration debugging
2026-01-10 - Citation and PaperMetadata should share a common BibliographicEntry base class - they're the same type of object (bibliographic references) with different use contexts
2026-01-10 - Garbage detection should use soft suspicion modifiers for years, not hard boundaries - avoid breaking humanities citations or future cutting-edge work (2028+ thesis prep)
2026-01-10 - Garbage detection caps should be raised when multiple signals from same category fire (e.g., 4 bio signals = 80 point cap instead of 60)
2026-02-26 - legacy script-style tests moved to tests/legacy/ and excluded from pytest discovery (norecursedirs); superseded by proper pytest equivalents
2026-02-27 - DOI resolution chain: Crossref for metadata, Unpaywall primary for OA PDF, Semantic Scholar fallback - no crawling needed for most papers
2026-02-27 - doi_only pipeline path: when no OA PDF found, synthesize from Crossref abstract and write to vault/Papers/ with note that it's abstract-only
2026-02-27 - GROBID on Apple Silicon: force engine:wapiti for all models via mounted config - avoids TF/DeLFT AVX crash under QEMU; filed bug with grobid/grobid project
2026-02-27 - Web article content saved as Original Content section in note (long-term storage approach TBD)
